title: Which Avenger are you? Free Marvel quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Marvel quiz: answer 12 questions to find which Avenger you are: Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow or Spider-Man. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Genius inventor, natural leader or god of thunder? Answer 12 questions about how you handle a crisis, a team and a day off to find your Avenger.
about: The Avengers work because they are so different: Tony Stark's genius and ego, Steve Rogers's principles, Thor's courage, Bruce Banner's mind and temper, Natasha Romanoff's skill and loyalty, Peter Parker's humor and sense of responsibility. This quiz matches you with one of these six.

Your result names your Avenger and shows your scores for all six. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Marvel or Disney; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Iron Man (Tony Stark), Captain America (Steve Rogers), Thor, Hulk (Bruce Banner), Black Widow (Natasha Romanoff) and Spider-Man (Peter Parker).

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every Avenger appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Why isn't Hawkeye (or my favorite) in the quiz?
faq.a: Six results keep the quiz short and every result equally easy to get. More heroes may join in a later update.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

items.q: The alarm goes off: the city is under attack. You…
options: Charge straight in
Crack a joke and swing into action
Slip in quietly from a side entrance
Head to the lab to work out what's going on
Alone in the lab until you lose track of time
A long, peaceful walk in the countryside
Building something brilliant in the garage
A training session, then dinner with your closest friends

items.q: In a team, you're the one who…
options: Makes sure everyone has fun
Needs space when things get heated
Holds everyone to what's right
Shows up with the biggest energy
Your ego
Your past
You trust too much in old-fashioned ideas
You're always running late

items.q: What do you bring to a party?
options: Terrible puns
The fanciest drinks
Endless stories of your victories
A quiet presence in the corner

items.q: How do you handle a bully?
options: Challenge them to a fair fight
Stand up to them, even if you lose
Try very hard not to lose your temper
Find out everything about them first
A flying suit you designed yourself
Web-shooters you built in your bedroom
A machine to help you control your strength
A shield that always comes back
Hurting someone without meaning to
Not being worthy
Being controlled by someone else again
Failing to protect the world you built

items.q: How do you make big decisions?
options: By asking what's right, not what's easy
By trusting your gut and your genius
By thinking about who could get hurt
By following your heart, loudly

items.q: What would your friends tease you about?
options: Never telling anyone what you really feel
Getting far too angry over board games
Doing homework in between saving the day
Saying "language!" at every swear word
The family you chose
Being worthy of your name
Leaving the world safer than you found it
Using your gifts to look out for your neighborhood
Lead from the front, by example
Read the room and act when it counts
Inspire with a big speech and a bigger hammer

ironman.name: Iron Man
ironman.body: You are brilliant, inventive and confident, and you'd rather build the solution yourself than wait for one. Like Tony Stark, you can be a little too sure of yourself, but you'll give everything for the people you love.

cap.name: Captain America
cap.body: You have a strong sense of right and wrong and you stand by it, even when it's hard. People trust you to lead. Like Steve Rogers, you never stop standing up for the little guy.

thor.name: Thor
thor.body: You are big-hearted, brave and full of energy, and you love a good feast with friends. Like Thor, you've learned that true strength is about being worthy, not just being powerful.

hulk.name: Hulk
hulk.body: You are a deep thinker with a lot of power inside, and you work hard to keep it under control. Like Bruce Banner, you're at your best when your head and your heart work together.

widow.name: Black Widow
widow.body: You are skilled, observant and calm under pressure, and you keep your feelings close. Like Natasha Romanoff, you'd do anything for the family you chose.

spiderman.name: Spider-Man
spiderman.body: You are funny, curious and full of heart, juggling a busy life with doing the right thing. Like Peter Parker, you know that great power comes with great responsibility.
